decisions.reason: Eliminating Big Block prizes does not change the referral milestones or conditions for awarding badges.
The badge set, icon rules, and badge presentation remain valid independently of Big Block removal.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes Big Block messaging and updates the FAQ to the remaining Small Block prizes and revised $15 allocation.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes obsolete Big Block counter, eligibility, and post-draw semantics while retaining the operational fact that the Big Block ticket lifecycle was removed.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already changes each successful coded referral from Small and Big Block tickets to one Small Block ticket.
Eliminating Big Blocks does not change use of the NFT mint number as the permanent referral code or any of its display locations.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already narrows eligible winners to holders of Small Block tickets; the random, on-chain Chainlink VRF selection rules remain unchanged.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already narrows the no-code random ticket award to a Small Block prize ticket.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the $5 primary-mint allocation and identifies the Small Block prize pool as the active pool.
The source changes the primary-mint allocation and removes Big Blocks but does not change the required flat $10 secondary-sale royalty.
Removing Big Block prizes does not alter automatic prize transfer, winner announcements, or winner notification channels for the remaining prizes.
The source preserves the recurring $500 Small Block mechanism and does not change its existing one-winner, every-100-sales rule.
